Title: Modern Applied Statistics with S(Statistics and Computing)
Fourth Edition
Author:W.N. Venables and B.D. Ripley
Paperback: 506 pages
Publisher: Springer (December 1, 2010)
ISBN-10: 1441930086
ISBN-13: 978-1441930088

Contents:
1.Introduction
2.Data manipulation
3.The S language
4.Graphics
5.Univariate statistics
6.Linear statistical models
7.Generalized linear models
8.Non-linear and smooth regression
9.Tree-based methods
10.Random and mixed effects
11.Exploratory multivariate analysis
12.Classification
13.Survival analysis
14.Time series analysis
15.Spatial statistics
16.Optimization

booksite:
http://www.stats.ox.ac.uk/pub/MASS4/
